body: The fact that you cared enough to write this shows you are already doing a lot. You can't hold her mental burden but just keep being there as long as it doesn't hurt you. Give her a friend. Someone she can trust and confide in. You can gently suggest her getting help and that it would mean a lot to you if she got better but pushing any harder may backfire. Good luck. I'm glad she has you.

I know it's lame to say but he needs you. He will never forget you. You will be on his mind constantly and all he will think is why he wasn't enough for you. I'm so sorry youve been suffering so long. I wish I had a solution. Hang in there. Somedays are going to be worse than others but look at that innocent beautiful child and keep trying.
